title: New-build sales slow sharply as mortgage rates stay high
summary: Developers reported a 22% year-on-year drop in new-build sales in the third quarter as market mortgage rates stayed above 20%.

articles.title: New-build sales slow sharply as mortgage rates stay high
articles.text:
Residential developers sold 22% fewer new-build flats in the third quarter than a year earlier, according to an industry survey of the 30 largest developers.

Market mortgage rates stayed above 20%, while subsidised programmes now cover only families with children. Developers responded by postponing new projects: the number of new construction starts fell by 18%.

Suppliers of building materials report longer payment terms from developers and a slowdown in orders for the winter season.

key_facts.text: New-build sales fell 22% year on year in Q3
